source_text: Moyses percussit Seon et Og; Iesus reges citra Iordanen. Lex praecurrit; Christus consummat. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Moses struck Sihon and Og; Jesus kings on-this-side Jordan. Law runs-before; Christ completes. Amen.
pass_b_english: Moses struck Sihon and Og; Jesus the kings west of Jordan. The law runs ahead; Christ completes. Amen.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Joshua homilies; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105
